title: Raitha Siri Scheme
department: Department of Agriculture, Government of Karnataka

scheme_details.description: A Karnataka agricultural initiative intended to encourage millet cultivation, including nutrient-rich traditional millet crops.
eligibility: Farmers cultivating eligible millet crops, subject to the applicable scheme guidelines
Farmers meeting the eligibility conditions in the relevant government notification

money_benefits.subsidy: Historical programme information records financial assistance of Rs. 10,000 per hectare for millet growers. Current eligibility and rates require official verification.
money_benefits.direct_financial_assistance: Not independently verified for the current financial year.

application_process: Visit the official Karnataka Agriculture Department website.
Contact the nearest Raita Samparka Kendra or local Agriculture Officer.
Ask whether Raitha Siri applications or benefits are available for the current financial year.
Confirm the eligible millet crops, land requirements and incentive amount.
Obtain the official application form and document checklist, if applications are open.
Submit the application through the prescribed channel.
Complete any required verification before benefit disbursement.
benefits: May provide financial incentives to eligible millet growers under applicable guidelines
scheme_details.implemented_by: Department of Agriculture, Government of Karnataka

data_source.notes: The incentive amount is based on historical programme information. Verify the latest government order before treating it as current.
